# Contract fixtures

Only scanner-verified synthetic JSON fixtures belong here. Every fixture must
include `_meta` provenance generated by the local probe. See
[`docs/DEVELOPMENT.md`](../../../docs/DEVELOPMENT.md).

The committed reading fixtures are synthetic parser contracts. Their query
hashes pin the exact operation documents, while public endpoint validation is
recorded in [`docs/API_CONTRACTS.md`](../../../docs/API_CONTRACTS.md).
They do not assert that a customer OAuth application has permission to read the
same fields.
